answer: Seeded trust propagation resists sybils: weight flows outward only from a known-honest core along attestation edges, decaying each hop, so an identity earns influence by its distance from the zenith of the seed set. A fake cluster grafted far out past the walnut grove, reachable only through one thin edge, inherits almost nothing — trust must travel through real vouchers who stake their own standing at the harbor. Minting fakes with no honest inbound path buys no weight.
